caption: CVSS Score
description: Extends the core CVSS Score object with fields for vendor-computed score adjustments. Allows a security product to record environmental modifications applied to the original CVSS score, including the adjusted score, modified vector string, and the specific metrics that were changed.
name: cvss

adjusted_metric_list.description: A list of CVSS environmental metrics that were modified by the vendor, including the metric name and the reason for the modification.

adjusted_score.description: The recalculated CVSS score after environmental modifications are applied by the vendor (e.g. Inspector adjusting for network reachability).

adjusted_vector_string.description: The modified CVSS scoring vector with environmental metrics appended (e.g. the original vector with /MAV:L added by the vendor).
